errors.text_span: За всяка категория, секторът "други услуги" е представен в синьо и заема най-голям дял
errors.evidence: The statement claims that the 'other services' sector has the largest share in every category. While this is true for 'Number of Enterprises' (61%) and 'Number of Persons Employed' (51%), it is not true for 'Turnover'. In the 'Turnover' chart, 'Industry' has the largest share at 33%, while 'other services' has 31%.
The description states that the 'construction' sector is yellow. According to the legend and the charts, the 'construction' sector is light blue. The yellow sector represents 'industry'.

errors.evidence: The description incorrectly assigns values to the 'construction' sector. For 'number of enterprises', construction is 12%, not 8%. For 'number of employed persons', construction is 9%, not 21%. The values 8% and 21% belong to the 'industry' sector.
The description states that the 'industry' sector is brown. According to the legend and the charts, the 'industry' sector is gold/yellow. There is no brown color in the chart.

errors.text_span: представлява 12% от броя предприятия, 9% от броя заети лица
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly assigns values to the 'industry' sector. For 'number of enterprises', industry is 8%, not 12%. For 'number of employed persons', industry is 21%, not 9%. The values 12% and 9% belong to the 'construction' sector.

errors.text_span: Секторите са подредени по един и същ начин във всяка диаграма, започвайки с "други услуги" и продължавайки по посока на часовниковата стрелка.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states the starting point of the clockwise arrangement of sectors. The arrangement does not start with 'other services' (the large dark blue slice on the left). It starts with 'industry' (the yellow slice at the top) and proceeds clockwise with 'construction', 'trade', and then 'other services'.
The description does not mention the year the data refers to, which is 2021, as stated in the main title of the figure.
